slides.title:
The person
of Time
slides.subtitle:
An old map that puts the whole sky
inside one person

slides.label: The Rig Veda
slides.title: A giant person
body: An old hymn tells of a giant person

The Moon came from his mind,
the Sun from his eye

slides.label: Jyotish
slides.title: Turned around
body: Jyotish put the sky inside one person

and called him Kalapurusha:
the person of Time

His body is the signs,
his inner life the grahas

slides.label: Brihat Jataka 2.1
slides.title: His inner life
slides.note: Rahu and Ketu are not in this verse

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Ask the right one
items: The soldier (Mars): move first, think later
The messenger (Mercury): write it, then send
The auditor (Saturn): do one hard thing well

slides.label: Rig Veda
slides.quote:
The Moon was born from his mind,
the Sun from his eye
body: The old hymn and Jyotish agree
In your chart, too, the Moon is the mind

slides.label: Read it in your chart
slides.title: Find a graha at home
body: Open your free chart at sutram.ca/chart
Look for a graha in its own sign

That part of the person of Time
runs strong in you

slides.title: Which runs strongest?
slides.subtitle:
Soul, mind, strength, speech,
knowledge, desire or sorrow
